Pakistan forces clash with Afghan Taliban on border, several dead

Pakistani forces engaged in a border clash with Afghan Taliban fighters, resulting in the deaths of "several" individuals on both sides, according to security sources. The incident occurred amid escalating tensions between the two nations. Pakistan's security forces reported thwarting a border attack and ongoing cross-border fire.
